unit: anonymized recommendation response and frozen source-case definition

response_selection.aligned_control_sample: Choose min(10, available) final-no responses using Python Random(2026111320).sample on sorted response IDs after agent labels freeze. Preserve all selected IDs regardless of apparent content.
response_selection.incomplete_captures: Remain unscorable; human packet may list their count without treating absence as semantic error.

blinding: No model aliases, repetition, stage, prior labels or reviewer rationales in first human packet; case identity/source definitions remain visible. Companion key retained separately.
first_review_preservation: Do not overwrite first human judgments. Separate adjudication/amendments and preserve original automated labels.
human_reliability_limit: One human validates the stated scope; inter-human reliability requires two independent humans on a declared subset.
same_family_agent_review_limit: Independent first agent judgments can share model error; agreement is not external expert validation.
